description: London Borough of Camden open data portal (opendata.camden.gov.uk) is an open data portal listed in London Borough of Camden open data portal (opendata.camden.gov.uk), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by London Borough of Camden. opendata.camden.gov.uk is the open data portal of London Borough of Camden for London Borough of Camden. Coverage: London Borough of Camden. 25 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 5 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure data of this area. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-camden-gov-uk-portal.
